images.prompt: Empty boardroom table at night; a single document with completely blank pages, one red pen beside it, no chairs occupied.
images.usage: Facebook + X (16:9). LinkedIn and Instagram take the full 10-slide carousel.
images.qa: Approved first roll. The blank pages were the risk — a document on a boardroom table is what an image model fills with fake signature lines — and nothing leaked. Red carried by a pen, not an indicator, per the standing lesson.
